analysis.title: Marketcolour + Earnings 28 Oct 2026 (Ioannis Blekos, FICC & Equities)
key_insights: US equities closed Tuesday higher: SPX +60bps to 7722 (6/11 sectors up, Tech +1.49%, Energy -2.20%), NDX +129bps to 29651 (first back-to-back 1%+ gain in 3 months), RTY +116bps to 2818.
AI trade showed more signs of stabilization: GS Data Centers basket (GSTMTDAT) +4.21% and AI Semis basket (GSCBSMHX) +3.10% both outperformed.
In Europe, Semis (GSSBSEMI) +5.4%, EU Miners (GSXEMINE) +2.4% and Housebuilders (GSSBUKHO) +2.3% outperformed on gilt yield stabilisation.

FOMC preview: market pricing of the Fed path has taken out one hike and now peaks at just over 4.5%. GS baseline and probability-weighted Fed forecasts are considerably less hawkish, because GS is skeptical the FOMC will hike four times and expects cuts down the road.

Historical pattern around first Fed hikes: equities tend to struggle initially but recover quickly, yields rise into the first hike, the curve keeps flattening (especially in larger cycles), and the real trade-weighted USD tends to strengthen into the hike with mixed performance afterwards.
Pension rebalancing: $9bn to sell ranks in the 50th percentile of all buy and sell estimates in absolute dollars over the past three years and the 65th percentile going back to Jan 2000.

Momentum is recovering (+2.5%) after a ~20% drawdown over recent weeks. GSPRHIMO high beta momentum is up ~8% over the last 3 sessions. Global fundamental LS momentum exposure is near YTD lows after the de-grossing episode.

SK Hynix (+11%) reported revenue of 104tr won ($78bn, +328% y/y) vs consensus 98tr won and operating profit of 88tr won vs consensus 76tr won. It plans to return up to $75bn to investors, has long-term agreements with 14 major customers covering more than 50% of 2027 and 2028 capacity, and expects memory demand to outpace supply through 2030.

Reckitt (BUY, PT GBP6.5, 20% upside): GS expects a Q4 acceleration as headwinds subside and cold/flu expectations rise, to +6.3% for Core Reckitt, implying +3.8% organic sales growth in FY26 and +4.9% in FY27E.

BASF Q3 adj EBITDA beat by 10%, driven by all divisions except Agri Solutions and lower corporate costs. Volumes were weaker than expected but price realisation held up better in upstream divisions. Guide raised by 100m at the top end, which implies a notable Q4 slowdown. FCF guide is unchanged despite the capex guide being cut by 400m.

ASM beat and raise: Q3 revenue beat by 5% and gross profit by 6%. Q4 2026 revenue guide of €1.23bn +/-5% at constant currency is +3% vs consensus at the midpoint. 2027 revenue is guided above €5.7bn at cc, 5% ahead of consensus and above the €3.7-4.6bn range given at the CMD.

Dassault Systemes (DSY): the Q3 beat was driven by licences and the upgraded full-year guidance largely reflects the inclusion of ArisGlobal. The headline looks better than the underlying picture after a strong stock rally. Q3 revenue beat consensus by 2%. Next catalyst is the CMD on 17 November.

BNP Q3: 7% net profit beat from a 2% top-line beat and in-line costs, driven by better Equities. A E1.3bn buyback was announced, which opens the door for more at FY results. Provisions were 8% higher but cost of risk was stable at 40bps. Stock expected up 2-3%.

KONE Q3 was light: orders +5.5% in line (Schindler's were >+10%), sales growth 3.4% vs consensus +5%, adj EBIT 2% miss despite in-line margins. Guidance raised at the low end: sales growth 4-6% (from 3-6%), margins 12.5-12.9% (from 12.3-13%).

Saint-Gobain Q3: slight organic miss with France especially weak. Americas were helped by Roofing (vs industry volumes -13%), but this looks temporary as the company flags a deterioration in Q4 organic growth with US destocking and ongoing pressures.

market_movers.rationale: Reckitt: GS expects a Q4 acceleration to +6.3% Core Reckitt as headwinds fade and cold/flu expectations rise, with 20% upside to the target.
SK Hynix: revenue 104tr won vs consensus 98tr and operating profit 88tr vs 76tr, with a $75bn shareholder return plan and 2027-28 capacity covered by long-term agreements. Stock +11%.
ASM beat and raise: Q3 revenue 5% beat, 2027 revenue guide above €5.7bn is 5% ahead of consensus.
BNP: 7% net profit beat, E1.3bn buyback announced, stock expected up 2-3%.
KONE: Q3 sales growth 3.4% vs consensus +5% and a 2% adj EBIT miss, though guidance was raised at the low end.
Saint-Gobain: slight Q3 organic miss, weak France, and Q4 organic deterioration flagged on US destocking.
BASF: Q3 adj EBITDA 10% beat and guide raised by 100m at the top end, but guidance implies a Q4 slowdown.

sector_views.rationale: AI Semis basket +3.10% in the US and European Semis +5.4%, with SK Hynix and ASM results beating and guiding higher.
KONE's miss is read as a market share and large-order swing toward Schindler, whose orders grew >10%.
Saint-Gobain flags Q4 organic deterioration, US destocking and weak France.

earnings_insights: SK Hynix reported: revenue 104tr won ($78bn, +328% y/y) vs consensus 98tr won, operating profit 88tr won vs consensus 76tr won.
BASF reported Q3: adj EBITDA 10% above consensus. Guide raised by 100m at the top end (whisper was for the top end), FCF guide unchanged, capex guide lowered by 400m.

ASM reported Q3: revenue 5% above consensus, gross profit 6% above. Q4 2026 revenue guide €1.23bn +/-5% at cc (+3% vs consensus at midpoint). 2027 revenue guide above €5.7bn at cc, 5% ahead of consensus.
Dassault Systemes reported Q3: revenue 2% above consensus, driven largely by licences. Full-year guidance raise largely reflects ArisGlobal.
BNP reported Q3: net profit 7% above consensus, top line 2% above, costs in line, provisions 8% higher than consensus but cost of risk stable at 40bps. E1.3bn buyback announced.

KONE reported Q3: orders +5.5% (in line), sales growth 3.4% vs consensus +5%, adj EBIT 2% below consensus, margins in line. FY guide: sales growth 4-6%, adj EBIT margin 12.5-12.9%, vs consensus +5.2% growth and 12.6% margin.
Saint-Gobain reported Q3: slight organic miss, France especially weak, Americas helped by Roofing vs industry volumes -13%. Q4 organic deterioration flagged.
Reckitt (GS estimates, not reported): Core Reckitt Q4E +6.3%, FY26 organic sales growth +3.8%, FY27E +4.9%.

DSY's guidance raise is mostly an acquisition effect, so the underlying picture may disappoint after the rally.
